These screenshots were rendered locally from the two public example card HTML
snippets supplied by the user, with the visual CSS and Ubuntu Sans font extracted
from the supplied HAR. Team logo images are removed as in the original export.

Native layout: 360px wide, 1.25 scale, light Betano theme. The browser capture is
450 × 339 due to fractional height; exported cards use its first 338 rows.
The references use Chromium 156. Playwright 1.64.0 pins that same browser branch;
older Chromium releases differ in fractional zoom layout and font rasterization.

They contain only the user-provided example teams, markets and odds. The HAR,
account API responses, request headers and other browsing resources are excluded.
